mutations.name: every branch-PR read lists the repository again
mutations.find: if (hit && now() - hit.at < (options.ttlMs ?? PR_TTL_MS)) return hit.read;
kills: the branch PR reader reuses a repository's list for a minute, then reads it again

mutations.name: an older PR on the same head replaces the newest
kills: the branch PR reader gives each branch its newest PR by head, with the checks summary, and no absolute path

mutations.name: a failed gh pr list loses GitHub's reason
kills: the branch PR reader marks PR state unread, not failing, when GitHub cannot be listed

mutations.name: a clone with no GitHub origin is listed anyway
kills: the branch PR reader asks GitHub nothing for a clone with no GitHub origin
